source.name: dakar.com - Partners (Host country: Saudi Arabia)
source.note: dakar.com lists 'Host country: Saudi Arabia' with a link to visitsaudi.com, the Visit Saudi tourism platform. Human Rights Watch (3 Jan 2020) described a five-year deal between ASO and the Saudi government for the 2020 edition.

note: Host-country partnership since the 2020 Saudi debut; the country is in the event title ('Dakar Rally Saudi Arabia 2027'). Host fee not published. Castera (Motorsport.com es, 4 Jun 2023): rally to stay in Saudi Arabia until at least 2029.
